projects.name: AI-Powered Semantic Search Platform (Second Brain)
projects.description: Full-stack RAG pipeline using Qdrant and Gemini AI for semantic vector search and automated memory clustering across multi-format web data. A dedicated Python microservice isolates embedding generation and vector computations from the Node.js server. Redis and BullMQ provide event-driven asynchronous processing, reducing perceived API latency from approximately 12 seconds to under 150 milliseconds. Qdrant payload indexes enable under 50ms similarity search latency for more than 100,000 embeddings.

projects.name: Automated Accessibility CI/CD Pipeline (Accessify)
projects.description: GitHub Actions and webhooks automate Gemini AI-powered semantic WCAG audits inside pull requests. A serverless event-driven extraction layer uses Browserless to scan live DOM nodes and stores accessibility health metrics and audit trails in Supabase through Deno Edge Functions. A local runtime bypass reduced pre-commit execution latency from approximately 3.5 seconds to under 100 milliseconds.
